title: Human-readable story title
timeframe: Exact period if known; otherwise mark to verify
shortSummary: 2-3 sentences explaining the situation, what the candidate did, and why the story matters.
situation: Customer/account context, opportunity context, business problem, technical environment, and stakes.
task: What the candidate was personally responsible for accomplishing and what success looked like.
actions: Technical or architectural work the candidate owned.
How the candidate partnered with Sales, Product, Engineering, or another stakeholder.
How the candidate navigated disagreement, risk, or ambiguity.
fullStory: Complete interview-ready narrative in the candidate's natural speaking style.
interviewQuestions: Questions this story is especially strong for.
technicalTopics: Relevant technologies, products, architecture patterns, or domains.
lessonsLearned: What changed in how the candidate operates afterward.
followUpQuestions: Questions an interviewer is likely to ask to pressure-test the story.

confidentiality.level: Public-safe | Confidential customer-safe | Internal-only | Needs review
confidentiality.guidance: How to safely describe the story.

status: Draft - needs verification | Interview-ready | Needs update
sourceNotes: Facts or metrics that still need verification.
